draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.35, the 38th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 6th of 35 at WR. He went 52nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: George Pickens. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (90th percentile), vertical jump (84th percentile), broad jump (98th percentile). College production: 845 receiving yards in 2023, 18th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 33 career games and 12 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 2 so far in 2026. Still developing: 5 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: drop rate 2.7% (77th percentile). Weak spots: catch rate 44.6% (2nd percentile), yards after catch per reception 2.4 (8th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 453 receiving yards against a median of 290, above the norm.
